description: Hand-labelled claim/passage support pairs built from QueueProof unit-test fixtures (tests/synthesis.test.ts). This is NOT production data and NOT a benchmark of live retrieval; it is a small before/after diagnostic for the optional citation-support verifier.
construction: passage = evidence title + ". " + excerpt, the same string lib/server/citation-verifier.ts sends to the sidecar.

emitted_claim (supported): claims synthesiseGroundedAnswer actually emitted when run on the fixture inputs of the named test case, paired with the evidence it cited. Each was re-read and confirmed supported.

contradiction_summary: contradiction summaries synthesis emitted (paraphrased, multi-receipt), paired with the concatenation of their cited passages; two hand-written misstatements (swapped dates, negated state) are labelled not_supported.
paraphrase (supported): hand-written rewordings of a fixture fact that the passage fully states.
mutated_claim (not_supported): an emitted or fixture claim with one changed date, ID, owner, project, value, or a negation, paired with its original passage.

cross_evidence (not_supported): an emitted claim paired with a different evidence item from the same fixture that does not state it. Borderline: the BUG-123 claim vs linear-1 (linear-1 states the outage and Atlas Launch but never names BUG-123) is labelled not_supported.

Labels were assigned by one reader; there is no inter-annotator agreement. Fixture ids reused across tests (billing-linear, billing-slack) resolve to the billing deadline conflict (medical-billing distractor) case for hand-written rows.
